title: Free standard shipping on orders over $75
prompt: Marketing wants free standard shipping for orders whose goods come to $75.00 or more (price times quantity, before any discount and before tax). Express shipping is never free. When the threshold is met, the standard shipping charged on the order, and the standard quote returned by `POST /shipping/quote` for the cart, is 0; delivery time estimates do not change. The threshold is an exported constant, `FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD` (in cents), in shipping/service.ts for now.
